title: Network-aware neuronal activity phenotyping across a complete CRISPRi screen
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Classify each CRISPRi guide against non-targeting controls from neuronal activity representations, comparing Plexus with manual features. Gene discovery/significance is not itself an ordered improvement target.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Classify each CRISPRi guide against non-targeting controls from neuronal activity representations, comparing Plexus with manual features. Gene discovery/significance is not itself an ordered improvement target.

Source-paper comparison for Original Figure 4 per-guide AUROC, preserving both complementary well folds and donor strata: AUROC is computed by sklearn roc_curve and auc from guide-positive classifier probabilities; retain the same score unit, eligible cases and two folds. The plotted 0.8 cutoff is not the paper baseline.
success_criteria: Recover the complete original cohort, data version, fold identities and author AUROC results before admission.
Beat the original source-paper metric under its same input/exposure and preprocessing conditions; preserve all guide/donor results and controls.
A four-line whole-plate result, corrected preprocessing protocol or held-plate calibration result is a separately labelled extension.
Freeze a meaningful effect and uncertainty rule before final scoring; no victory from the 0.8 display cutoff, extra significant genes or numerical reconstruction.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
participant_inputs: Version-bound processed neural trace/spike/mask arrays plus well/plate/cell-line metadata for every released perturbation and negative control. Released embeddings or held-data-trained checkpoints cannot replace neuronal inputs.
